name: How does site selection impact green building performance?

mainEntity.name: How does site selection impact green building performance?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing flat sites, preserving existing trees/soil, orienting for passive solar, and avoiding flood zones reduces grading, erosion, and energy needed for heating/cooling. wbdg​
